content: Claude Code v2.1.88 leak key findings beyond memory convergence: Anti-distillation system (fake tool injection to poison competitor training via ANTI_DISTILLATION_CC flag). Undercover mode (strips Co-Authored-By and AI attribution from Anthropic employee commits, 'There is NO force-OFF'). BUDDY Tamagotchi (18 species, RPG stats, Mulberry32 PRNG). KAIROS named after Greek 'the right moment' — kairos vs chronos, qualitative vs quantitative time. 108 feature-gated modules including ULTRAPLAN (30-min cloud Opus planning), Coordinator Mode (multi-agent mailbox), VOICE_MODE, CHICAGO_MCP (computer use). autoDream: 3 gates (24h+ since last, 5+ sessions, lock available), 4 phases (orient/gather/consolidate/prune), 200-line/25KB memory cap. Frustration regex telemetry. Model codenames: Tengu=Claude Code, Fennec=Opus 4.6, Capybara/Mythos=new tier above Opus. 5,594-line print.ts with 3,167-line function at 12 nesting levels.
